title: Asymptotically Tight Bound for the Conflict-Free Chromatic Index
summary: The conflict-free chromatic index of a graph $G$ is the minimum number of colours in an edge colouring of $G$ such that the neighbourhood of every edge contains a colour appearing exactly once. Its vertex analogue is the conflict-free chromatic number. These two parameters naturally coincide when the second is applied to the line graph of $G$. It is known that two variants of the latter parameter exhibit substantially different behaviour.
